description: This file defines the Drupal form class 'FieldConfigEditForm' for editing field configuration settings within the Drupal 'field_ui' module. It includes methods for building, validating, submitting, and saving the form, as well as handling AJAX interactions and exceptions.

classes.name: FieldConfigEditForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for editing field configuration settings, including form building, validation, submission, AJAX handling, and exception management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique form ID for this form.

methods.description: Builds the form array for editing field configuration, including field settings, default values, and AJAX callbacks.

methods.name: afterBuild
methods.description: Delegates afterBuild processing to the subform or parent.

methods.description: Copies submitted form values into the entity object, updating field storage based on subform data.

methods.description: Recursively checks if any form element is marked as required.

methods.description: Defines form actions such as Save, Delete, and Change field type, with AJAX callbacks.

methods.description: Handles AJAX form submission, providing validation feedback or redirect on success.
